title: Rare change: Why the NFL's 2026 cut deadline is being held on a Sunday for the first time in 22 years

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Rare change: Why the NFL's 2026 cut deadline is being held on a Sunday for the first time in 22 years
